_comment: What the ship gate builds its sandbox from (ship/gatecopy.py, ship/toolchain.py, ship/sandboxrun.py). Names only: no secret list lives here (that is data/never_pack.json).
_dependency_dirs: Directories the copy links to the real ones, mounted read-only, instead of copying. A `marker` is a file that must be inside for the name to count (a `venv/` package of source code is not a virtual environment).
_build_output_dirs: A directory left out of the copy when the file named is beside it: the tests rebuild it in the (writable) copy.
offline_failures: attempting to make an HTTP request, but --offline was specified
Failed to establish a new connection
Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement
_declares_dependencies: A file at the workspace root and the directories that would hold what it declares: when the file is there and none of the directories is, a missing module is most likely a dependency that was never installed.
